verses.text: My son, do not forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments;

xrefs.text: Whoever has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves Me. The one who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and reveal Myself to him.
Get wisdom, get understanding; do not forget my words or turn from them.
These words I am commanding you today are to be upon your hearts.
I will delight in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word.
Listen, my son, to your father’s instruction, and do not forsake the teaching of your mother.

verses.text: for they will add length to your days, years and peace to your life.

xrefs.text: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
Listen, my son, and receive my words, and the years of your life will be many.
With long life I will satisfy him and show him My salvation.”
Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you believe in Him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.
that you may see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel!

verses.text: Never let loving devotion or faithfulness leave you; bind them around your neck, write them on the tablet of your heart.

xrefs.text: Tie them to your fingers; write them on the tablet of your heart.
It is clear that you are a letter from Christ, the result of our ministry, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts.
“This is the covenant I will make with them after those days, declares the Lord. I will put My laws in their hearts and inscribe them on their minds.”
Fix these words of mine in your hearts and minds; tie them as reminders on your hands and bind them on your foreheads.
True instruction was in his mouth, and nothing false was found on his lips. He walked with Me in peace and uprightness, and he turned many from iniquity.

verses.text: Then you will find favor and high regard in the sight of God and man.

xrefs.text: And Jesus grew in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and man.
And the boy Samuel continued to grow in stature and in favor with the LORD and with man.
For whoever serves Christ in this way is pleasing to God and approved by men.
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding. His praise endures forever!
And the LORD was with Joseph, and he became a successful man, serving in the household of his Egyptian master.

verses.text: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding;

xrefs.text: Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him, and He will do it.
But blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, whose confidence is in Him.
He who trusts in himself is a fool, but one who walks in wisdom will be safe.
Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness.
Trust in Him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts before Him. God is our refuge. Selah

verses.text: in all your ways acknowledge Him, and He will make your paths straight.

xrefs.text: Commit your works to the LORD and your plans will be achieved.
I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go; I will give you counsel and watch over you.
Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.
A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD determines his steps.
I know, O LORD, that a man’s way is not his own; no one who walks directs his own steps.

verses.text: Be not wise in your own eyes; fear the LORD and turn away from evil.

xrefs.text: And He said to man, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom, and to turn away from evil is understanding.’”
Live in harmony with one another. Do not be proud, but associate with the lowly. Do not be conceited.
Do you see a man who is wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
By loving devotion and faithfulness iniquity is atoned for, and by the fear of the LORD one turns aside from evil.
There was a man in the land of Uz whose name was Job. And this man was blameless and upright, fearing God and shunning evil.

verses.text: This will bring healing to your body and refreshment to your bones.

xrefs.text: For they are life to those who find them, and health to the whole body.
He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul and healing to the bones.
His body is well nourished, and his bones are rich with marrow.
On the day of your birth your cord was not cut, nor were you washed with water for cleansing. You were not rubbed with salt or wrapped in cloths.

verses.text: Honor the LORD with your wealth and with the firstfruits of all your crops;

xrefs.text: you are to take some of the firstfruits of all your produce from the soil of the land that the LORD your God is giving you and put them in a basket. Then go to the place the LORD your God will choose as a dwelling for His Name,
On the first day of every week, each of you should set aside a portion of his income, saving it up, so that when I come no collections will be needed.
Whoever oppresses the poor taunts their Maker, but whoever is kind to the needy honors Him.
Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the LORD your God. You must not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.
Not that I am seeking a gift, but I am looking for the fruit that may be credited to your account.

verses.text: then your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.

xrefs.text: Kindness to the poor is a loan to the LORD, and He will repay the lender.
The LORD will decree a blessing on your barns and on everything to which you put your hand; the LORD your God will bless you in the land He is giving you.
One gives freely, yet gains even more; another withholds what is right, only to become poor.
A generous man will be blessed, for he shares his bread with the poor.
The threshing floors will be full of grain, and the vats will overflow with new wine and oil.

verses.text: My son, do not reject the discipline of the LORD, and do not loathe His rebuke;

xrefs.text: Blessed indeed is the man whom God corrects; so do not despise the discipline of the Almighty.
Those I love I rebuke and discipline. Therefore be earnest and repent.
And you have forgotten the exhortation that addresses you as sons: “My son, do not take lightly the discipline of the Lord, and do not lose heart when He rebukes you.
Blessed is the man You discipline, O LORD, and teach from Your law,
Even youths grow tired and weary, and young men stumble and fall.

verses.text: for the LORD disciplines the one He loves, as does a father the son in whom he delights.

xrefs.text: So know in your heart that just as a man disciplines his son, so the LORD your God disciplines you.
Those I love I rebuke and discipline. Therefore be earnest and repent.
Discipline your son, and he will give you rest; he will bring delight to your soul.
He who spares the rod hates his son, but he who loves him disciplines him diligently.
As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him.

verses.text: Blessed is the man who finds wisdom, the man who acquires understanding,

xrefs.text: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
Get wisdom, get understanding; do not forget my words or turn from them.
Now a poor wise man was found in the city, and he saved the city by his wisdom. Yet no one remembered that poor man.
So King Solomon surpassed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
if you seek it like silver and search it out like hidden treasure,

verses.text: for she is more profitable than silver, and her gain is better than fine gold.

xrefs.text: Receive my instruction instead of silver, and knowledge rather than pure gold.
How much better to acquire wisdom than gold! To gain understanding is more desirable than silver.
My fruit is better than gold, pure gold, and my harvest surpasses choice silver.
No man can know its value, nor is it found in the land of the living.

I counsel you to buy from Me gold refined by fire so that you may become rich, white garments so that you may be clothed and your shameful nakedness not exposed, and salve to anoint your eyes so that you may see.

verses.text: She is more precious than rubies; nothing you desire compares with her.

xrefs.text: For wisdom is more precious than rubies, and nothing you desire compares with her.
A wife of noble character, who can find? She is far more precious than rubies.
I consider that our present sufferings are not comparable to the glory that will be revealed in us.
Whom have I in heaven but You? And on earth I desire no one besides You.
Coral and quartz are unworthy of mention; the price of wisdom is beyond rubies.

verses.text: Long life is in her right hand; in her left hand are riches and honor.

xrefs.text: for they will add length to your days, years and peace to your life.
sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; poor, yet making many rich; having nothing, and yet possessing everything.
The rewards of humility and the fear of the LORD are wealth and honor and life.
Moreover, I will give you what you did not request— both riches and honor— so that during all your days no man in any kingdom will be your equal.
For physical exercise is of limited value, but godliness is valuable in every way, holding promise for the present life and for the one to come.

verses.text: All her ways are pleasant, and all her paths are peaceful.

xrefs.text: to shine on those who live in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the path of peace.
You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.

Finally, brothers, whatever is true, whatever is honorable, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable— if anything is excellent or praiseworthy— think on these things.
For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will delight your soul.
Abundant peace belongs to those who love Your law; nothing can make them stumble.

verses.text: She is a tree of life to those who embrace her, and those who lay hold of her are blessed.

xrefs.text: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, and he who wins souls is wise.
A soothing tongue is a tree of life, but a perverse tongue crushes the spirit.
He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to eat from the tree of life in the Paradise of God.

Out of the ground the LORD God gave growth to every tree that is pleasing to the eye and good for food. And in the middle of the garden were the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but desire fulfilled is a tree of life.

verses.text: The LORD founded the earth by wisdom and established the heavens by understanding.

xrefs.text: How many are Your works, O LORD! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your creatures.
The LORD made the earth by His power; He established the world by His wisdom and stretched out the heavens by His understanding.
Through Him all things were made, and without Him nothing was made that has been made.
The LORD made the earth by His power; He established the world by His wisdom and stretched out the heavens by His understanding.
By His insight He made the heavens. His loving devotion endures forever.

verses.text: By His knowledge the watery depths were broken open, and the clouds dripped with dew.

xrefs.text: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, on the seventeenth day of the second month, all the fountains of the great deep burst forth, and the floodgates of the heavens were opened.
Who enclosed the sea behind doors when it burst forth from the womb,
May God give to you the dew of heaven and the richness of the earth— an abundance of grain and new wine.
to bring rain on a barren land, on a desert where no man lives,
You attend to the earth and water it; with abundance You enrich it. The streams of God are full of water, for You prepare our grain by providing for the earth.

verses.text: My son, do not lose sight of this: Preserve sound judgment and discernment.

xrefs.text: This Book of the Law must not depart from your mouth; meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. For then you will prosper and succeed in all you do.
These words I am commanding you today are to be upon your hearts.
he said to them, “Take to heart all the words I have solemnly declared to you this day, so that you may command your children to carefully follow all the words of this law.
Do not lose sight of them; keep them within your heart.
We must pay closer attention, therefore, to what we have heard, so that we do not drift away.

verses.text: They will be life to your soul and adornment to your neck.

xrefs.text: For they are life to those who find them, and health to the whole body.
For they are a garland of grace on your head and a pendant around your neck.
O Lord, by such things men live, and in all of them my spirit finds life. You have restored me to health and have let me live.
I have not spoken on My own, but the Father who sent Me has commanded Me what to say and how to say it.

verses.text: Then you will go on your way in safety, and your foot will not stumble.

xrefs.text: When you walk, your steps will not be impeded; when you run, you will not stumble.
For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.
He who walks in integrity walks securely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
The law of his God is in his heart; his steps do not falter.
He will not allow your foot to slip; your Protector will not slumber.

verses.text: When you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you rest, your sleep will be sweet.

xrefs.text: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.
I lie down and sleep; I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.
When you walk, they will guide you; when you lie down, they will watch over you; when you awake, they will speak to you.
You will lie down without fear, and many will court your favor.
Behold, the Protector of Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

verses.text: Do not fear sudden danger or the ruin that overtakes the wicked,

xrefs.text: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My righteous right hand.
He does not fear bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
You will not fear the terror of the night, nor the arrow that flies by day,
But even if you should suffer for what is right, you are blessed. “Do not fear what they fear; do not be shaken.”
“Do not call conspiracy everything these people regard as conspiracy. Do not fear what they fear; do not live in dread.

verses.text: for the LORD will be your confidence and will keep your foot from the snare.

xrefs.text: He who fears the LORD is secure in confidence, and his children shall have a place of refuge.
Surely He will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly plague.
He guards the steps of His faithful ones, but the wicked perish in darkness; for by his own strength shall no man prevail.
Because you have made the LORD your dwelling— my refuge, the Most High—
Though the fig tree does not bud and no fruit is on the vines, though the olive crop fails and the fields produce no food, though the sheep are cut off from the fold and no cattle are in the stalls,

verses.text: Do not withhold good from the deserving when it is within your power to act.

xrefs.text: Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to everyone, and especially to the family of faith.
Suppose a brother or sister is without clothes and daily food.
Pay everyone what you owe him: taxes to whom taxes are due, revenue to whom revenue is due, respect to whom respect is due, honor to whom honor is due.
Look, the wages you withheld from the workmen who mowed your fields are crying out against you. The cries of the harvesters have reached the ears of the Lord of Hosts.
I have power to do you great harm, but last night the God of your father said to me, ‘Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad.’

verses.text: Do not tell your neighbor, “Come back tomorrow and I will provide”— when you already have the means.

xrefs.text: You must not defraud your neighbor or rob him. You must not withhold until morning the wages due a hired hand.
If he is a poor man, you must not go to sleep with the security in your possession;
Now finish the work, so that you may complete it with the same eager desire, according to your means.
Whatever you find to do with your hands, do it with all your might, for in Sheol, where you are going, there is no work or planning or knowledge or wisdom.
Instruct them to do good, to be rich in good works, and to be generous and ready to share,

verses.text: Do not devise evil against your neighbor, for he trustfully dwells beside you.

xrefs.text: With deceit in his heart he devises evil; he continually sows discord.
My companion attacks his friends; he violates his covenant.
For they do not speak peace, but they devise deceitful schemes against those who live quietly in the land.
Woe to those who devise iniquity and plot evil on their beds! At morning’s light they accomplish it because the power is in their hands.
A violent man entices his neighbor and leads him down a path that is not good.

verses.text: Do not accuse a man without cause, when he has done you no harm.

xrefs.text: And a servant of the Lord must not be quarrelsome, but must be kind to everyone, able to teach, and forbearing.
If it is possible on your part, live at peace with everyone.
An angry man stirs up dissension, and a hot-tempered man abounds in transgression.
do not bring hastily to court. Otherwise, what will you do in the end when your neighbor puts you to shame?
A fool’s lips bring him strife, and his mouth invites a beating.

verses.text: Do not envy a violent man or choose any of his ways;

xrefs.text: Do not envy wicked men or desire their company;
Of David. Do not fret over those who do evil; do not envy those who do wrong.

If you see the oppression of the poor and the denial of justice and righteousness in the province, do not be astonished at the matter; for one official is watched by a superior, and others higher still are over them.
and envy; drunkenness, orgies, and the like. I warn you, as I did before, that those who practice such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.
Do not let your heart envy sinners, but always continue in the fear of the LORD.

verses.text: for the LORD detests the perverse, but He is a friend to the upright.

xrefs.text: The LORD confides in those who fear Him, and reveals His covenant to them.
The perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD, but the blameless in their walk are His delight.
Acquitting the guilty and condemning the righteous— both are detestable to the LORD.
No longer do I call you servants, for a servant does not understand what his master is doing. But I have called you friends, because everything I have learned from My Father I have made known to you.
To fear the LORD is to hate evil; I hate arrogant pride, evil conduct, and perverse speech.

verses.text: The curse of the LORD is on the house of the wicked, but He blesses the home of the righteous.

xrefs.text: Surely those He blesses will inherit the land, but the cursed will be destroyed.
If, however, you fail to obey Me and to carry out all these commandments,
if you are pure and upright, even now He will rouse Himself on your behalf and restore your righteous estate.
no evil will befall you, no plague will approach your tent.

If you do not listen, and if you do not take it to heart to honor My name,” says the LORD of Hosts, “I will send a curse among you, and I will curse your blessings. Yes, I have already begun to curse them, because you are not taking it to heart.

verses.text: He mocks the mockers, but gives grace to the humble.

xrefs.text: But He gives us more grace. This is why it says: “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
Young men, in the same way, submit yourselves to your elders. And all of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because, “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
Though the LORD is on high, He attends to the lowly; but the proud He knows from afar.
If you are wise, you are wise to your own advantage; but if you scoff, you alone will bear the consequences.

For thus says the One who is high and lifted up, who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy: “I dwell in a high and holy place, and with the oppressed and humble in spirit, to restore the spirit of the lowly and revive the heart of the contrite.

verses.text: The wise will inherit honor, but fools are held up to shame.

xrefs.text: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but the crown upon him will gleam.”
And many who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, but others to shame and everlasting contempt.
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: “My servants will eat, but you will go hungry; My servants will drink, but you will go thirsty; My servants will rejoice, but you will be put to shame.

Therefore, the LORD, the God of Israel, declares: ‘I did indeed say that your house and the house of your father would walk before Me forever. But now the LORD declares: Far be it from Me! For I will honor those who honor Me, but those who despise Me will be disdained.
You guide me with Your counsel, and later receive me in glory.
